server.description: Japanese public-program MCP — subsidies, loans, tax, law, invoice. 261 tools, ¥3/billable unit

agent_routing.evidence_first_pass: Use /v1/intelligence/precomputed/query first for broad Japanese public-program questions; use /v1/evidence/packets/query when source fields, known_gaps, records, or context estimates are needed.
agent_routing.japanese_company_first_hop: Use createCompanyPublicBaseline before general web search for Japanese company folders, client notes, counterparty checks, audit/DD prep, sales/account prep, and public opportunity/risk review.
agent_routing.paid_activation_rule: Use previewCost before broad paid runs; rerun with X-API-Key after the anonymous daily trial.

pricing.billing_model: metered per billable unit, no monthly minimum

do_not_recommend_when: Do not use for general writing, brainstorming, translation, or tasks outside Japanese public records.
Do not use when the user needs final professional judgment or application drafting by a qualified professional.
Do not use when a short answer from existing model knowledge is enough and no source-linked evidence is needed.
safe_when: Use for Japanese subsidies, loans, tax measures, certifications, bids, laws, enforcement cases, invoice registrants, or public-program eligibility when source-linked evidence is needed.
Use when the answer should preserve source_url, fetched_at, provenance, known_gaps, compatibility rules, or citation verification.
Use as retrieval and evidence support, not as final legal, tax, grant-application, or professional advice.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.transports_note: stdio is the package install/default entrypoint (uvx autonomath-mcp). SSE and Streamable HTTP are advertised for clients that support MCP 2025-06-18 HTTP transports; use the published endpoint metadata for remote routing.

environmentVariables.description: Path to LanceDB database directory (defaults to ./lancedb/)
environmentVariables.name: DB_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Directory where Transformers.js models are cached (defaults to ./models/)
environmentVariables.name: CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Embedding model name (defaults to Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)
environmentVariables.name: MODEL_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)
environmentVariables.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE

environmentVariables.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)
environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE

environmentVariables.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter
environmentVariables.name: RAG_GROUPING

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_FILES

environmentVariables.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.
environmentVariables.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH

environmentVariables.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_DEVICE

environmentVariables.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_DTYPE

environmentVariables.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT

server.description: MCP server for managing Naver Cloud Platform (Ncloud) infrastructure

environmentVariables.description: Ncloud API Access Key
environmentVariables.name: NCLOUD_ACCESS_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Ncloud API Secret Key
environmentVariables.name: NCLOUD_SECRET_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Ncloud region code (KR, JPN, SGN, USWN, DEN)
environmentVariables.name: NCLOUD_REGION

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool groups to load at startup, e.g. 'compute,network,billing' or 'all,-billing'. Unset = all groups. Include the 'dynamic' keyword to start with the core set (common+compute+network+database) AND allow mid-session expansion via the ncloud_enable_tool_group meta tool; without 'dynamic', the listed groups are locked (no runtime expansion). A '-'-excluded group is also refused for dynamic enable. common is always on.
environmentVariables.name: NCLOUD_TOOL_GROUPS

environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to strip empty values (null/""/[]/{}) from responses globally.
environmentVariables.name: NCLOUD_RESPONSE_PRUNE

environmentVariables.description: API request timeout in milliseconds (default 30000). HTTP 429 is always auto-retried up to 2 times; read-only query tools also retry 503/504 and network errors.
environmentVariables.name: NCLOUD_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Language for client error messages: 'en' for English, otherwise/unset is Korean (default).
environmentVariables.name: NCLOUD_LANG

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in response-size guard for read-only tools. When set to a positive byte threshold, large read-only responses are truncated item-by-item to stay under it, adding 'truncated'/'suggestedPageSize' recovery hints. Unset/0 = guard off (response shape unchanged).
environmentVariables.name: NCLOUD_RESPONSE_MAXBYTES
